provenance.source: the catalog's source 1, a DJ set that opens on deep house (mining id 1): cuts 1:100+585, 1:685+360, 1:1045+540 (104.7-109.1 BPM) and 1:2080+765 (119.9 BPM)
provenance.where: the bar before a sixteen-bar line inside a main where the development has no pickup, and the bar into a drop or a breakdown
provenance.reading: the whole bar six decibels under the cycles before on 0.58 bars in 16 of the reference mains, most often one or two bars at a phrase's end (1:2080 bars 43, 66-67; 1:1045 bars 49-50)
provenance.idiom: everything but the pad out for one bar: the held chord alone, and the groove back on the line
provenance.knowledge: mined and the house's own idiom: the mains of four cuts read bar by bar (packages/mining/tools/readings.py with its bandThings, the mains pass's readings in the catalog); nothing sampled, no audio copied
provenance.moved: round M1, the mains pass, 10-02: a row of the house's mains, drawn by its weight among the rows of its kind where the theme is in its box
